items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: And he did for Billy Taylor’s book

ctx.x: Do you ever have trouble with bad copyists?

Oh yeah. Well my wife starting copying music out of desperation years ago because of that. She was in watercolors, she’s a very good artist. And my scores seem to be — when I tried to write parts it was horrible. My penmanship went from clear score to like ugly parts. So she started copying. And she became one of the busier copyists in New York City. And she would do not only my stuff but she did a lot of stuff like for Sondheim like for Broadway and she would do a lot of those kind of things. She was working…
